title.zh: Arduino 小项目：按键呼叫灯

brief.zh: 芽芽按住呼叫键时，值班员要看见亮灯，松开就要熄灭。为虚拟 UNO 设置灯的规则，运行程序，亲手按下、松开，检查两次读数。
brief.en: The attendant should see a lit lamp while Sprout holds the call button and a dark lamp when Sprout lets go. Set the rule on the virtual UNO, run the sketch, then press and release the button to check both readings.

concept.zh: 用 D2 读取呼叫键，用板载灯报告状态
concept.en: Read the call button on D2 and report its state with the onboard LED
